Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €374.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We have reviewed your proposal; however, extending payment terms to 90 days is not feasible, so we must maintain our standard 30 days net.
We are prepared to offer a revised price of EUR 370.50 per unit, provided we keep the 30-day payment terms.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We acknowledge your revised offer, but the minor adjustment is insufficient to reach an agreement at your proposed price level.
We are prepared to lower our price to EUR 373.85 per unit while accepting your requested 90-day payment terms.
This offer reflects a fair valuation given the extended payment period you require.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
